verdict.rationale: Microsoft's docs say Authenticator generates one-time password codes, works offline, and supports non-Microsoft accounts such as Amazon, Google and Facebook. That covers the TOTP core of the story. However, no doc in the pack describes the scan-a-QR-code-to-add-an-account flow; the QR mentions refer to downloading the app or Verified IDs. One hands-on user also reports a known, unfixed issue in the QR add dialog that they worked around by adding the account manually. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of adding a TOTP account by QR scan, evidence that codes start immediately after scanning, and resolution of the reported QR add-flow issue.
